notes.title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights - v0.1 Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[h3]The wait is finally over! 💜[/h3][p][/p][p]Dive into a cyberpunk metropolis as the mercenary, Zoey Madison. Find a way to navigate the seductive and corrupt Neon City. Choose who to trust, what to desire, and how far you'll go. Are you in it for the pleasure? Or will you stay pure?‎[/p][p][/p][h2]Play the demo today ♡[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]Zoey's latest contract takes her to the Glowing Hole: a brothel in the Red Light District of Neon City. There are three distinct ways for Zoey to accomplish her task.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus... an especially [b]perverted[/b] way to end it. 👀[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy experiencing them all![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/dde3cbcd7710152b736a70447ded8f074dd8ba48.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/f300046add56758501126f3b107996a18d09e5da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/793d826ac57cbd796d855499eb432424110f81fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/6f10a4004896b5bace74115fac491d5dbbf6cdeb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/85b91f0ede9ad09e01e71ba7c3cd31957a17ee9f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]We've put our hearts and souls into this release, utilizing everything we've learned from Third Crisis to completely blow our previous game out of the water. From animated overworld characters to fully voice-acted dialogue, this is truly an evolution of what you loved from Third Crisis and more.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this demo and stick around to see what the game looks like in the years to come![/p][p][/p][h2]Play the demo today ♡[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, we are actively developing the game, so make sure to hop onto our [url="https://discord.gg/tsCUtu4jNA"]Discord[/url] if you want to follow our progress or chat with us![/p][p]Your feedback and support will help shape the ultimate cyberlust experience.[/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/tsCUtu4jNA"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/813f5c501e5e9155eba35e2e48f4af9ece689fd7.png"][/img][/url][/p][p] [/p][h3]With Love,[/h3][h3]Anduo Games ♡[/h3][p]
